newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Romania's Foreign Minister Adrian Severin continues his diplomatic mission in the United States to lobby for support for Romania's early admmission to NATO.
* The government started its weekly cabinet meeting with a debate on banking bills.
* Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea will issue a statement this afternoon on the International Monetary Fund's decision to approve credits totalling $430 million for Romanian reforms.
